keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «마을 사람들이 나눌 음식이 없다고 한 것(문제)» 과 «모두가 냄비에 무언가를 넣은 것(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the villagers said they had no food to share) and the solution (everyone put something into the pot). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The villagers said they had no food to share.
Everyone put a little food into the stone soup.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: A tired traveler came to a small village with an empty pot.
a person who goes on a trip
He was hungry, but the villagers said they had no food to share.
people who live in a village
the villagers said they had no food to share
to give part of what you have to others
So he filled his pot with water and put a smooth stone inside.
A curious woman brought a carrot from her garden.
wanting to know or see something
Nobody had much alone, but together they made a big feast.

qs.q: Why did the curious woman bring a carrot?
qs.qko: 호기심 많은 여자는 왜 당근을 가져왔나요?
opts: The traveler said a carrot would make the soup better.
She wanted to eat the stone.
evs: So he filled his pot with water and put a smooth stone inside.
"I am making stone soup," he said. "It is delicious, but a carrot would make it better."
A curious woman brought a carrot from her garden.
He was hungry, but the villagers said they had no food to share.
why: 나그네가 당근이 있으면 수프가 더 맛있어진다고 말했어요. 그래서 여자가 당근을 가져왔어요.
The traveler said a carrot would make the soup better, so the woman brought one.

qs.q: In this story, what does "feast" mean?
opts: a big meal that many people eat together
a small snack for one person
a long walk in the village
evs: The soup smelled wonderful, and the whole village sat down to eat together.
A tired traveler came to a small village with an empty pot.
Then a farmer added some potatoes, and a boy brought onions.
So he filled his pot with water and put a smooth stone inside.
why: 마을 사람 모두가 함께 앉아 수프를 먹었어요. 그러니 여럿이 함께 먹는 큰 식사라는 뜻이에요.
The whole village sat down to eat together, so a feast is a big meal for many people.

qs.q: How did the village have enough food, even though they said they had none?
qs.qko: 마을 사람들은 음식이 없다고 했는데, 어떻게 모두가 먹을 만큼 생겼나요?
opts: Each person gave a little, and together it was a lot.
The traveler bought food in another town.
evs: So he filled his pot with water and put a smooth stone inside.
Soon, everyone in the village put something into the pot.
Nobody had much alone, but together they made a big feast.
A tired traveler came to a small village with an empty pot.
why: 모두가 냄비에 무언가를 넣었고, 혼자서는 적었지만 함께 모으니 큰 잔치가 되었어요. 두 문장을 이으면 알 수 있어요.
Everyone put something into the pot. Nobody had much alone, but together they made a big feast.

ends: The traveler visits another village with his stone.
나그네가 돌을 들고 다른 마을에 가요.
The villagers plan a sharing party every month.
마을 사람들이 달마다 나눔 잔치를 열기로 해요.

write.src: “If <u>everyone brings one thing</u>, we can <u>have a big party</u>.”
slotKo: 그러면 함께 할 수 있는 일
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «모두가 하는 일 + 그러면 함께 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what everyone does and what we can do together in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «If» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 한다», «we can» 뒤에는 동사로 시작해 보세요. (예: we can share our snacks)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «If», write who + what they do. After «we can», start with a verb. (e.g. we can share our snacks)

img.cover: In a small village square, a tired man with a gray hat and a long brown coat stirs a big black pot over a fire, while villagers gather around holding carrots, potatoes and onions.

scenes.1: Beside the big black pot over a fire, a woman hands a carrot to the tired man with a gray hat and a long brown coat, while a farmer carries potatoes and a small boy holds onions.
scenes.2: The whole village sits together at a long wooden table outside, eating bowls of soup and smiling, with the man in the gray hat and long brown coat among them and the big black pot nearby.
